text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — I'm wiring up ExternalSecrets for the payments-service today. Main thing: we need to map vault paths (KV v2) into k8s secrets and ensure rotation doesn't break pods. Planning to add a Terraform change to create the ExternalSecret + ServiceAccount. Any gotchas?
julia: Do we have a standard SA + RBAC snippet for ExternalSecrets? I remember an earlier service needed a rolebinding because the controller runs in a different ns.
maria: We usually create a namespaced SA for the app and a Role that permits `secrets/*` read for the specific `data/` path. Example (from memory):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: payments-secrets-reader
  namespace: payments
---
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: secret-reader
  namespace: payments
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
```
Then ExternalSecret points at the Vault path `secret/data/payments` (note the `data/` for KV v2).
kevin: thanks — good call on the `data/` prefix. Question: should we use ExternalSecrets' vault provider or the Vault Agent Injector + CSI? Pros/cons for rotation here?
sam: For short-lived dynamic creds (DB passwords) we leaned towards Vault Agent Injector + CSI because it handles TTL refresh in place. For static config secrets (API keys) ExternalSecrets is simpler and matches our IaC flow. If you want TTL rotation without pod restart, go CSI.
kevin: payments-service needs DB creds rotated transparently. So likely CSI + Vault Agent. But infra policy prefers ExternalSecrets for our Terraform-managed k8s resources. Can we have ExternalSecrets manage the non-rotating secrets and CSI handle DB creds?
maria: Yup that's what we do for billing-service. ExternalSecrets for configs, CSI for DB creds. Make sure to add the session policy in Vault to allow `read` on `kv/data/payments` and `read` on `database/creds/payments-role` as appropriate.
infra-bot: reminder: Vault KV v2 paths used by ExternalSecrets must include the `data/` segment in the `secretPath` field to read the latest version. Missing that is the most common cause of 403s.
julia: Also: when you change the ExternalSecret via Terraform, we patch the CR in-cluster which triggers a reconcile. If you're toggling providers (vault -> csi) for the same secret name, use a new k8s secret name to avoid races.
kevin: noted. I'm drafting a small TF change: create payments SA, Role, RoleBinding, ExternalSecret for `payments-config` and a separate VaultAgentConfig + CSI mount for `db-creds`. PR: https://git.company/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4822 — please review the RBAC + Vault policy bits. Would appreciate a quick look from @maria or @julia before I merge.
maria: will review in ~1h. If you can add a short upgrade note in the PR about the `data/` prefix and expected reconciliation behavior that'll help support.
kevin: will add the note. Plan to apply after approvals and monitor via `kubectl describe externalsecret payments-config -n payments` and Vault audit logs.
sam: pinging on the Terraform state change — make sure the new SA is added under the k8s provider config that points to the correct cluster (we have a gotcha where the staging provider was still set).
kevin: good catch, I'll double-check providers in the TF. Thanks all.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: created plan for MR 4822; 4 resources to add, 1 to change.
julia: acked — will skim later today.
kevin: cool, targeting EOD for merge if no blockers.
